title: Missing authorization in ASUS Armoury Crate allows a local attacker to write content into a specific file or registry…
description: A missing authorization vulnerability in ASUS Armoury Crate allows a local attacker to write content to a specific file or registry location with Local System privileges or cause a recoverable system crash via the service's exposed inter-process interface. This flaw requires local access and does not involve user interaction. The vulnerability is identified as CVE-2026-110464 with a medium severity rating.
